extraction: Parsed the Zitrin team *_arcs.txt input image lists from the MAST HFF lens models. Unlike the CATS files these carry explicit provenance: Z_SPEC (0.000000 when absent), REDSHIFT_REF, Z_ADOPT (adopted from previous works or photometric z) and F? (whether the redshift was left FREE, i.e. model-optimised). z_flag='spec' when Z_SPEC>0, else 'adopted_phot_or_model' using Z_ADOPT. The zitrin-nfw and zitrin-ltm-gauss files are byte-identical (same sha256) so only one copy is parsed per cluster. No arc position angles are present.
note: EMBEDDED-IN-LENS-MODEL IMAGE LIST for 2 of the 6 clusters (Zitrin ships arcs.txt only for Abell 2744 and MACS J0416). Per cluster (images / spectroscopic / adopted-nonspec): Abell 2744 83/15/68; MACS J0416.1-2403 94/53/41. The z_free_in_model column (Y/N) records whether that system's redshift was a FREE PARAMETER optimised by the lens model - Y means the redshift is model-optimised, not measured.
